title: Two cases of TBL1XR1 heterozygous variants in children: a new splicing site variant identification and functional analysis through molecular docking and molecular dynamics simulation.
authors: Xie, Yaxue; Zhang, Ziyan; Zhu, Gang; Li, Zhichao; Zhang, Huiling; Zhang, Jiaqi; Wan, Lin; Yang, Guang
one_liner_zh: 该文通过分子对接和MD模拟分析TBL1XR1蛋白变异对其与NCOR1互作的影响，属于广义蛋白-蛋白互作而非TF-DNA体系，但MD/对接方法可迁移至蛋白-DNA互作建模，故给予中档评分。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Transducin beta-like 1 X-linked receptor 1 (TBL1XR1) protein is an important component of NCoR/SMRT complex. The variants of TBL1XR1 are associated with Pierpont syndrome (PS) and developmental delay (DD). This study aimed to discover new TBL1XR1 variants, their clinical manifestations, and protein-level changes. METHODS: Whole-exome sequencing was used to identify patients with TBL1XR1 variants in 2024. Minigene assay was used to investigate specific splice site, which was further validated by Sanger sequencing. Structural changes in the TBL1XR1 protein were analyzed using PyMOL and molecular dynamics (MD) simulations. Potential binding partners were predicted via Genecards, STRING, and Cytoscape, while molecular docking was employed to assess how variants affect protein complex interactions. RESULTS: Two novel TBL1XR1 variants (c.1048-8_1049del and c.865-7A>G) were identified in two patients. Patient 1 exhibits global developmental delay (GDD), while patient 2 displays with facial dysmorphism and autism spectrum disorder. c.865-7A>G is a non-canonical splicing variant causing abnormal mRNA splicing. SpliceAI and RDDC predicted its splicing pattern. Minigene analysis found a 6 bp (TCTCAG) insertion in mRNA, leading to two amino acid (SQ) insertion in the TBL1XR1 protein. Therefore, P2 was diagnosed with PS. Variant changed the local hydrogen bond network and electrostatic potential. MD simulations showed variant changed the conformation of TBL1XR1 protein. Protein-protein interaction analysis selected NCOR1 for docking with TBL1XR1. Their interaction was reduced after the insertion of SQ, which may contribute to the occurrence of PS. CONCLUSION: This study reported two patients manifesting with GDD and PS, which were identified with two novel variants of TBL1XR1 (c.1048-8_1049del, p.(N350X)) and (c.865-7A>G, p.K288_T289insSQ), respectively. c.865-7A>G variant might lead to PS by reducing its interaction with NCOR1.
abstract_zh: 背景：转导素β样1 X连锁受体1（TBL1XR1）蛋白是NCoR/SMRT复合物的重要组分。TBL1XR1的变异与Pierpont综合征（PS）和发育迟缓（DD）相关。本研究旨在发现新的TBL1XR1变异、其临床表现及蛋白水平变化。方法：采用全外显子组测序在2024年识别携带TBL1XR1变异的患者。使用小基因分析（minigene assay）研究特定剪接位点，并通过Sanger测序进一步验证。利用PyMOL和分子动力学（molecular dynamics, MD）模拟分析TBL1XR1蛋白的结构变化。通过Genecards、STRING和Cytoscape预测潜在结合伙伴，同时采用分子对接评估变异如何影响蛋白复合物相互作用。结果：在两名患者中识别出两个新的TBL1XR1变异（c.1048-8_1049del和c.865-7A>G）。患者1表现为全面发育迟缓（GDD），而患者2表现为面部畸形和自闭症谱系障碍。c.865-7A>G是非经典剪接变异，导致异常mRNA剪接。SpliceAI和RDDC预测了其剪接模式。小基因分析发现mRNA中插入6 bp（TCTCAG），导致TBL1XR1蛋白中插入两个氨基酸（SQ）。因此，患者2被诊断为PS。该变异改变了局部氢键网络和静电势。MD模拟显示变异改变了TBL1XR1蛋白的构象。蛋白-蛋白相互作用分析选择NCOR1与TBL1XR1进行对接。在SQ插入后，它们的相互作用减弱，这可能有助于PS的发生。结论：本研究报道了两名分别表现为GDD和PS的患者，并分别识别出两个新的TBL1XR1变异（c.1048-8_1049del, p.(N350X)）和（c.865-7A>G, p.K288_T289insSQ）。c.865-7A>G变异可能通过减弱其与NCOR1的相互作用导致PS。
